en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Musa Bin Al Akeyl Al Numeyri, from Al A’ala Bin Sayaba,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[17:9] Surely this Quran Guides to that which is most upright.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid from Musa ibn ’Ukayl al-Numayri from al-‘Ala’ ibn Sayyaba from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
who has said the following about the words of Allah.
“This Quran shows the way to that which is the most upright . .” [17:9]
The Imams (a.s.)said, “It guides to the Imam (a.s.).”
